title: review_identity capture hits its 40 s deadline on a Flutter repo with submodules, blocking a review from starting
outcome: No TermAl code change. Ordinary TermAl review already uses committed Git identity. The opt-in raw capture stays unchanged. Comovo owns its separate procedure change to committed BASE + COMMIT review under Greg's authority.
acceptance: A note, with source evidence, states that TermAl's ordinary review and resume paths use the candidate's Git commit/tree and changed status, and never call the raw full-environment review identity.
The Comovo unblock is recorded as Comovo's own procedure change (committed BASE + COMMIT review) under Greg's word, with its owner.
No new scanner, gate or capture variant is added; the raw tool stays an unchanged explicit opt-in.
